atomic_turn_semantics_v2.implementation_boundary: This is a consumer interface/constraint for Hooke and parent, not a request for designer to modify traditional controller. Frozen semantic_proposal.v1 stays unchanged; derive bag relations from current clause/component/spans/corrections or abstain when representation is insufficient.
atomic_turn_semantics_v2.input: One authoritative pre-turn state S and a finite bag E of source-bound proposed clauses; preserve original speech offsets, scope and explicit correction relations independently of serialization order.
metamorphic_properties: For nonconflicting E with the same source spans/relations, project_state(R(S,E)) == project_state(R(S,permutation(E))). Projection compares business state, unresolved set, readback/offer terms and next-dialogue requirement, not arbitrary serialization IDs.
Duplicate delivery of the same source event/evidence has no additional transition, persuasion attempt or bank write; source IDs are checked by the trusted kernel.

Row partition/coalescing that preserves scope and collective relations preserves results. Changing actual words/correction order can legitimately change results; it is not a permutation-invariance test.

An unfinished component in target A cannot erase a complete nonconflicting component in B. A recorded bank receipt is immutable historical evidence; a paid claim may change only through an explicit fresh scoped correction and policy, never generic confirm fallthrough.
atomic_turn_semantics_v2.phase_1: Validate envelope/binding/spans and resolve target scope before any mutation. Build per-(target,component,terms_epoch) evidence sets. Unknown scope stays unresolved; no broadcast from missing target.
atomic_turn_semantics_v2.phase_2: For a component, identical evidence/value hypotheses deduplicate; absent supplies no update; one consistent complete asserted normalized value can satisfy that component; incompatible asserted alternatives without a supported correction relation yield conflict/clarification. Negated/quoted/conditional evidence never silently supplies an asserted value.
atomic_turn_semantics_v2.phase_3: Resolve explicit replacement/retraction edges using actual speech sequence and trusted prior revision, not array position. Later serialization is not later speech. If supersession is ambiguous/cyclic or correction scope unresolved, retain diagnostics and block dependent joint frame.
atomic_turn_semantics_v2.phase_4: Apply one target patch after all its evidence is reconciled. Update U_next=(U_old union new_unresolved_or_invalidated_components) minus independently_completed_components_of_current_epoch. A merely mentioned old cached value cannot discharge a new correction obligation.
atomic_turn_semantics_v2.phase_5: Invalidate only obsolete refusal/offer/readback references for changed targets; preserve independent sibling facts and recorded receipts. Only after all target patches are assembled may kernel choose next clarification/readback/action under source policy.
atomic_turn_semantics_v2.refusal_ref: DeferredRefusal=(target_id, disposition_epoch, terms_revision, spoken_offer_id_or_null, originating_turn_id). Eligible only if all relevant current references match and current disposition still permits refusal handling. A fresh voluntary proposal starts its own episode; an unresolved replacement clarifies that episode rather than reviving the obsolete refusal.

implementation_boundary: Atomic rules constrain the independent deterministic consumer; this scaffold emits no state patch or authority and does not implement unsupported graph relations in frozen wire.

narrow_head_experiment.annotation_counting: Class-specific group sets can overlap; do not add21+82 and call103independent groups. For the40-group annotation pilot choose20positive and20additional negative groups disjoint from the selected positives when possible, annotate all used group members, and recount adjudicated classes after review. If disagreements leave fewer than20eligible groups/class, collect more; do not count author-labelled quotas as passed.
annotation_gate: Parent/authorized reviewer blindly annotates at least20positive TRAIN lineage groups and20negative TRAIN lineage groups without author labels or model predictions, including every member used in loss for selected groups. Use source context only; preserve disagreements for independent adjudication.

Negative TRAIN sample must include policy-sensitive and linguistically close alternatives (refusal, correction/new terms, historical paid, question, support, stop, hardship, conditional/quoted acts) and ordinary negatives. Select by a predeclared annotation sampling plan, not model correctness.

Two blind annotations plus adjudication for critical ambiguities; where author label was not blind independent evidence, do not count it as the independent second annotation. If only one new reviewer exists, report single-review status and keep the stricter data gate unsatisfied.

All descendants stay grouped. At least20groups/class is an engineering screen for THIS binary task only; it is neither IID proof nor a safety bound. Do not require every rare29way class or every untrained head to cross that floor before this subset can be studied.

Freeze a new version of reviewed labels/group manifest; owner preserves previous158-row pack/model/evidence. Designer does not relabel worker files. Collect separate development cases covering missing positive and hard-negative strata if using them for model choice.
narrow_head_experiment.freeze_sequence: Annotate TRAIN/development -> select CPU architecture/config on development -> freeze model/features/export/label semantics -> independent calibration_fit -> freeze temperature -> independent calibration_risk with predeclared selection rule -> freeze thresholds/OOD/consumer -> blind qualification. Collecting calibration may be planned before model freeze, but never leak its labels into training/selection. Final qualification remains unopened until complete freeze.
narrow_head_experiment.gpu_gate: Do not require all rare heads learned before this subset experiment. Nevertheless current zero adjudicated gold and unresolved class/feature/span effects do not establish a CPU ceiling; GPU remains NO-GO. Parent-only reservation and Modal timing/billing controls unchanged.
narrow_head_experiment.initial_model: Small binary sparse logistic head with context allowlist; label y=1 iff independently adjudicated primary==payment_proposal. Ambiguous primary labels are masked. Compare same frozen architecture with text-only and train-label-shuffled controls; use group weighting so many descendants do not dominate.
narrow_head_experiment.loss: For each head h, average masked loss within each annotated lineage group before averaging over groups; then average chosen head objectives. Optional TRAIN-only class weighting uses inverse sqrt of labelled GROUP counts, normalized and clipped to at most5, declared before development comparison. Keep an unweighted control; class weights do not calibrate probabilities or establish label reliability.
narrow_head_experiment.qualification: Apply existing exact grouped risk/coverage protocol to the eventual accepted binary semantic decisions for their stated population only; m=0 stays unqualified. Full bank actions require additional independently qualified dependencies and end-to-end source gates. Shadow trial can report learning/utility before safety qualification but cannot call it safe deployment.
narrow_head_experiment.task: Binary diagnostic head primary_is_payment_proposal, using only independently reviewed primary-act labels. Positive means primary act is payment_proposal; negative means another primary act, never absence of secondary payment, refusal, invalidity or permission.

trainable_mask.component_completion_and_polarity: diagnostic oracle-span only until minority labels/normalization distinction and span detection are reviewed
trainable_mask.primary_is_payment_proposal: eligible for scoped independently annotated pilot; currently weak labels only, not accepted
trainable_mask.rare_primary_classes: may retain exploratory logits, never claim covered/qualified
trainable_mask.target_identity_clause_scope_offer_conse: not implemented/trained for admission; keep blocked

narrow_head_experiment.use: Offline proposal-extraction prioritization/diagnostic shadow only. A positive may suggest retaining payment semantics for the existing extractor/consumer; no suppression of stop/hardship/admin/security signals, no amount/date/target/reference/consent acceptance. Negative has no behavioral authority.
narrow_head_experiment.why_this_subset: Current annotated train has42positive rows in21declared groups and110negative rows in82groups. This is the only observed primary class crossing the20group engineering floor. It is a feasible annotation pilot, not already independently reviewed or statistically qualified.
narrow_head_experiment.wire_mapping: Binary score stays in offline head diagnostics/bundle. Positive may supply only a payment_proposal candidate under the existing unqualified ScoredIntent; negative is not a new wire intent and cannot emit refusal/no-payment/permission. Until calibration/qualification, decision=abstain. No new envelope field or dropped secondary act.
